projects.title: Cylinder Wake: Drag and Spatio-temporal Frequency Analysis
projects.summary: Image-based pipeline for extracting drag coefficients and vortex-shedding frequencies from soap film flow visualization experiments. Features cylinder detection, pathline velocity extraction, wake model fitting, and Dynamic Mode Decomposition for frequency analysis across varying Reynolds numbers and surface roughness values.

projects.title: Two-Stage Gearbox Optimizer
projects.summary: Uses differential evolution to minimize housing depth while satisfying AGMA gear stress, DE-Goodman shaft fatigue, bearing life, key, and retaining ring safety constraints. Optimization is constrained so that all selected components come from standard catalogs.
